messages.subject: Macquarie Real Assets | Country and stakeholder execution across critical infrastructure
messages.body:
Dear Macquarie Media Relations Team,

Please route this confidential executive note to Mr. Leigh Harrison, Senior Managing Director and Head of Real Assets, Macquarie Asset Management.

Macquarie's real-assets model is built on long-term stewardship of infrastructure that communities and economies depend on. As the portfolio expands across energy, utilities and digital infrastructure, especially in markets such as Brazil and Colombia, operating value increasingly depends on the quality of government, regulatory, community and institutional relationships surrounding each asset.

That creates a leadership need beyond investment execution. Portfolio companies benefit from a disciplined external-affairs model that connects public-sector relationships, ESG commitments, local participation, stakeholder issues and reputation risk with operating and asset-management priorities. Done well, it supports resilience, approvals, investment programs and the long-term licence to operate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional action management within a major industrial operation. Earlier in my career I spent five years in regulated banking, giving me an additional grounding in financial controls, client discipline and risk awareness.

I would value a conversation about where this combination could support Macquarie Asset Management's Real Assets platform or portfolio companies, particularly across Latin America, the Caribbean and other emerging markets where institutional relationships and responsible operating execution matter to asset value. My attached CV is tailored to that portfolio-level contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
